sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 features the following enhancement: Unified Vision-Language Foundation: Early fusion training on multimodal tokens achieves cross-generational parity with Qwen3 and outperforms Qwen3-VL models across reasoning, coding, agents, and visual understanding benchmarks.

sources.title: qwen/qwen3.5-9b • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 represents a significant leap forward, integrating breakthroughs in multimodal learning, architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility. This is a 9B parameter dense model, supporting a native context length of 262,144 tokens.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: Quantization This model is created by quantizing Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B to Q4_K_M using convert_hf_to_gguf.py and llama-quantize from llama.cpp. Target Users This model supports CPU and heterogeneous (CPU+GPU) inference deployment, making it suitable for users without a GPU.
